detailed_descriptions.en: This is a 3D romance simulation game . Explore the world using point-and-click controls to move, investigate locations, and interact with the heroine. By completing a variety of missions and mini-games , you can earn money and gradually build your relationship by increasing the heroine’s affection and trust . ■ Pure Romance Route What begins as an act of revenge slowly changes into something more. As Yuki spends time with Keiko, he gradually finds himself falling for her. Keiko, too, becomes unable to suppress her growing feelings through their interactions. Confess your love and work toward marriage. This is the game’s main storyline. ■ Revenge Route Introduce Keiko to a new part-time job in the nightlife industry. Record key moments of her new life and compile them into a video message. Send it as a final statement to the former boss you despise. Various events related to the main heroine will occur Your affection or love rating will increase depending on your choices during the drama (Be warned - making wrong choices will raise your criminal coefficient... Additionally, there are many mini-games available Some help you earn money, while others boost your affection or love ratings Raising your affection or love ratings through these will advance the main story Cabaret Hostess: Anri The shop's number one attraction At home, she spends her time watching anime, playing video games, or just lounging around lazily. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This is a 3D romance simulation game.

Explore the world using point-and-click controls to move, investigate locations, and interact with the heroine.

By completing a variety of missions and mini-games, you can earn money and gradually build your relationship by increasing the heroine’s affection and trust.

■ Pure Romance Route

What begins as an act of revenge slowly changes into something more.
As Yuki spends time with Keiko, he gradually finds himself falling for her.
Keiko, too, becomes unable to suppress her growing feelings through their interactions.
Confess your love and work toward marriage.
This is the game’s main storyline.

■ Revenge Route

Introduce Keiko to a new part-time job in the nightlife industry.
Record key moments of her new life and compile them into a video message.
Send it as a final statement to the former boss you despise.

Various events related to the main heroine will occur

Your affection or love rating will increase depending on your choices during the drama

(Be warned - making wrong choices will raise your criminal coefficient...

Additionally, there are many mini-games available

Some help you earn money, while others boost your affection or love ratings

Raising your affection or love ratings through these will advance the main story

Cabaret Hostess: Anri

The shop's number one attraction

At home, she spends her time watching anime, playing video games, or just lounging around lazily.

Her room is a mess

Protagonist: Hieda Yuki

Worked at a notorious black IT company called Nuitter Japan

Left due to workplace harassment by her boss, Iruma Ichiro

Now works as a part-time job-hopper

Looks like a typical playboy, but surprisingly has good common sense
